name: SA-Points Generation
definition: SA-Points are geometry-consistent 3D point clouds generated via triangulation between observed training views and rasterized extrapolated views, used for surface-aware coverage estimation.
summary: SA-Points Generation creates geometry-consistent 3D point clouds from a single view by triangulating dense correspondences between the reference and an extrapolated view, leveraging foundational 3D models and 3D Gaussian Splatting for scale-consistent, surface-aware results.
